items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Well, I haven't heard Mike play too much, but I heard him a few times.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I think they don't play there. No, I think they don't play there. That's where we're at first. I tried to play with Johnny. McDonald? Yeah, Johnny McDonald. I know Bill Cray used to tell me he went over there and played with Mike Trepanie. Yeah. He was in the city the other night. Mike?

Yeah, he and Joe Steve. They're not doing it. I don't know just why they can't get anything steady. No. Well, Mike's something like it's in the city. Yeah. They know how to handle it or put the people in the city. It's a one-sided deal or what? Well, I haven't heard Mike play too much, but I heard him a few times.

Yeah, he plays alright, but there's something like it. Some of it is. You know he drives a pony around? He's got a pony and a car and drives him around the channel. Yeah. That gets his kicks. I'm not done. Well, what happens at the New Orleans Jazz Club when you go up there to play? How does that work? I never have played there. I haven't played in years, so I don't know. I used to play a couple of games.
